text: How many people stand between you and any stranger on Earth?
In nineteen sixty-seven, Stanley Milgram tested it.
Letters could only pass between people who knew each other.
The ones that arrived went through about five people.
Why so few? Everyone knows a lot of people.
Say you know a hundred. Two steps out, that's ten thousand.
asr: Say you know 100. Two steps out, that's 10,000.

text: Five steps out: more people than live on Earth.
Online, it shrank: four point seven four, then three point five seven.
And the stranger? Probably a friend of a friend of a friend.
